# Project Instructions

- This is a Python Streamlit project.
- Keep the application entry point in `app.py`.
- Install dependencies from `requirements.txt`.
- Run the app with `streamlit run app.py`.
- Use `.github/skills/notebook-to-streamlit/SKILL.md` when changing the notebook-derived delivery promise logic or Streamlit UI.
- Treat `git+https://github.com/zhouy185/rosa-starter.git` as a read-only external dependency. Do not modify, fork, or push to that repository.
